items.title: Temple Warm White
items.goal: A warm candle procession composes the vessel as layered wax and flame, lantern contour, Jewelry cups, Organ vigils, and engraved Identity fields.

intent.concept: A warm candle procession composes the vessel as layered wax and flame, lantern contour, Jewelry cups, Organ vigils, and engraved Identity fields.
intent.design_intent: Preserve Temple reverence and the hard ceiling while replacing equal warm dimness with a deliberate ceremonial hierarchy led by Vintage candle cups and a slow asymmetric procession fold.
intent.why_exists: It is the white family's reverent slow look: warm, calm, readable, and intentionally incapable of becoming a party cue at its defaults.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: The Hull should feel softly revealed through dust, the outline should remain lantern-clear, Jewelry should read as small candle sources, and Identity should be warm and still enough to read.
intent.unique_topology: Golden-ratio and square-root-related clocks shape layered candle wells, flame and wax material, a broad asymmetric procession fold, six candle cups, independent Organ vigils, and a complete folded 74-pixel field.
intent.distance_silhouette: A steady warm contour with a very shallow lift preserves the whole ship throughout the slow dust cycle.
intent.close_detail: Six-head candle flames, height-biased Organ vigils, fine Hull dust rays, and subtle complete folded 74-pixel warm-plaque variation create a ceremonial close read.
intent.motion_grammar: Very slow signed candle material and a broad asymmetric procession fold reverse together through large wraps; all controls slew and no pulse snaps or strobes.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z define candle wells, layered flame/wax material, and the broad procession fold; pixelLocalIndex authors Jewelry candles, while fixtureId phases Organ vigils. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Slow candle-white material and soft light-through-dust rays.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Steady lantern contour with only a shallow warm lift.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero row of six restrained candle cups with native-white flames.
fixture_roles.Organs: Quiet individual vigils shaped by fixture phase and real height.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel warm vigil plaque from signIndex=index%74, with minimal full-surface lift and strong legibility.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel warm vigil plaque from signIndex=index%74, with minimal full-surface lift and strong legibility.
intent.jewelry_white: Vintage native white is limited to candle-flame cores; warm-neutral RGB carries the cup and halo so the Jewelry remains dimensional under the ceiling.
intent.palette_white_material: No palette exports. Warmth reaches the family maximum R:G:B ratio of 1.00:0.68:0.32 at full control, W=A remains exact, UV is zero, and the ceiling binds RGB and W/A.

controls.behavior: Sets the deliberately slow dust and vigil rates.
Reverses signed dust travel and the vigil breath together.
Sets shallow ceremonial intensity above the warm safety bed.
Adds only a gentle lift, with restrained Organ emphasis.
Sets spatial scale of the slow dust planes.
Sets the hard maximum for RGB and matched W/A while retaining a minimum non-black cap.
Sets candle temperature from neutral to the bounded tungsten-white RGB ratio.
Moves the body from warm-neutral RGB toward matched native W/A.
Adds a deliberately small native-white lift to candle and vigil cores.

intent.safety_floor: The ceiling maps to a minimum 0.06 cap and every role owns a positive bed, so Temple can be dim but never black.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Protect the candle-vigil restraint and hard ceiling. Do not brighten it into Wash, deepen it into Breathe, sharpen it into Shimmer, or turn it into a Chase.
intent.evidence_notes: The prior capture was uniformly brown-white across fixture families. The bold rework preserves exact public values and the two source audio handles while separating Hull candle material, protected contour, six-cup Jewelry, independent Organ vigils, and warm Identity. Exact saved-value silence/audio gates cover Titanic and test_bench; cross-model truth reports zero WRONG, WEAK, or DEAD controls. items.title: White Breathe
items.goal: One slow white inhale moves through the ship as five coordinated but non-identical breaths.

intent.concept: One slow white inhale moves through the ship as five coordinated but non-identical breaths.
intent.design_intent: Preserve the recognizable whole-rig breath while separating Hull volume, Silhouette crest, Jewelry pearls, Organ answers, and readable Identity.
intent.why_exists: It is the family's soft organism: a welcoming white motion that reads as one body without a synchronized flat pulse.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: The silhouette should stay visible through every exhale; Jewelry should reveal a sequential necklace inhale; Organs should answer the breath rather than merely copy its brightness.
intent.unique_topology: Two incommensurate scalar breaths combine with a signed oblique XYZ roll; role branches resample that envelope into physical breathing vocabularies.
intent.distance_silhouette: A travelling crest rides a continuous contour floor so the full vessel remains recognizable at the lowest point of the inhale.
intent.close_detail: Six-head pearl breathing, staggered par sources, Hull vertical volume, and gentle complete folded 74-pixel sign breath reward close viewing.
intent.motion_grammar: One signed clock reverses the whole breath and its quicker spatial roll; all phases use large seam-free wraps and controls slew smoothly.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z create the oblique rolling volume; pixelLocalIndex sequences Jewelry, and fixtureId offsets Organ breaths. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Broad luminous volume with a slow vertical lift.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Continuous contour carrying the clearest travelling breath crest.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero six-pearl necklace inhaling head by head with native-white cores.
fixture_roles.Organs: Staggered single-source answers to the shared inhale.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel breathing nameplate from signIndex=index%74; the full surface inhales while retaining a protected floor.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel breathing nameplate from signIndex=index%74; the full surface inhales while retaining a protected floor.
intent.jewelry_white: Native white concentrates in the sequential pearl crests; the rail bed stays warm-neutral RGB so the six heads retain visible shape between crests.
intent.palette_white_material: No colorPalette exports; warm-neutral RGB, W=A byte-identical, and U=0 make every breath white and globally untintable.

controls.behavior: Sets the shared breath and travelling-roll rates.
Reverses the shared inhale and travelling XYZ roll without a center freeze.

Adds a bounded breath pop and a restrained Organ emphasis.
Sets the spatial reach and scale of the travelling roll.
Sets inhale-to-exhale contrast without eliminating the safety bed.
Moves white energy from RGB toward matched dedicated W/A.
Strengthens Jewelry pearl cores and Organ white accents.
Warms neutral RGB while retaining the white-family neutrality bounds.

audio_handles.intent: A restrained kick briefly opens the breath without flattening the fixture-role hierarchy.

intent.safety_floor: Every role has a positive bed before depth is applied; a full exhale remains a complete, readable ship.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Protect the shared inhale grammar. It must not flatten into White Wash, fragment into Shimmer, travel as Chase bars, or become Temple's candle vigil.
intent.evidence_notes: Control names, declaration order, defaults, and source AUDIO_MODULATION_V1 handles are byte-for-value preserved; white_only saves an explicit unmodulated operator-review tune for every control. The old capture read as nearly uniform, so the rework adds cross-roll negative space, breathing ribs and voids, sequential Jewelry pearls, staggered Organ punctuation, and moving Identity diagonals while retaining one shared body breath. Cross-model truth reports zero WRONG, WEAK, or DEAD controls; exact saved-value silence/audio gates cover Titanic and test_bench. items.title: White Wash
items.goal: An elegant white satin sheet reveals the ship while five fixture families retain distinct lighting jobs.

intent.concept: An elegant white satin sheet reveals the ship while five fixture families retain distinct lighting jobs.
intent.design_intent: Replace the equal whole-rig wash with a complete but authored white composition: broad Hull material, protected contour, pearl-like Jewelry, discrete Organ punctuation, and calm Identity engraving.
intent.why_exists: It is the white family's versatile bread-and-butter look and practical work-light endpoint without surrendering fixture hierarchy.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: The ship should read immediately from distance as a luminous white vessel, while the rail Jewelry is visibly finer and brighter than the Hull surface and the signs remain deliberate.
intent.unique_topology: Two irrationally related XYZ satin planes form a broad material field; fixture roles reinterpret that field as folds, contour ripple, six-head pearls, discrete organ pulses, and sign engraving.
intent.distance_silhouette: Raw LED strands hold a continuous high white contour with restrained movement even when the Hull material enters a trough.
intent.close_detail: Jewelry facets, Hull satin grain, Silhouette contour, Organ breath, and complete folded 74-pixel sign engraving remain independently authored at close range.
intent.motion_grammar: Two signed long-wrap phase accumulators drift at a golden ratio; direction remains manually dominant and live controls slew without teleporting geometry.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z jointly determine the two material planes. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Broad satin-white material with a quiet longitudinal fold catch.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Protected far-field contour with only a restrained material ripple.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero six-pearl white sequence with the strongest native-white catchlight.
fixture_roles.Organs: Discrete structural punctuation, intensified by kick rather than flattened into wash.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel engraved satin nameplate from signIndex=index%74, with an authored full-surface floor and slow fold detail.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel engraved satin nameplate from signIndex=index%74, with an authored full-surface floor and slow fold detail.
intent.jewelry_white: Vintage rails are the native-white hero: an RGB white bed supports six-head pearl catchlights, with sliderWhiteKick reserved for the pearl cores.
intent.palette_white_material: No colorPalette exports. Warm-neutral RGB is shaped only by sliderWarmth; explicit W=A on every pixel and U=0 make the look immune to global palette tinting.

controls.behavior: Sets the drift rate of both satin material planes.
Reverses the signed material travel without a center freeze.
Sets authored whole-look intensity above the non-black role floors.
Adds a bounded whole-look pop and stronger Organ punctuation.
Sets the literal spatial scale of the satin planes.
Crossfades textured satin toward an even work-light field while preserving role hierarchy.
Moves the white balance from warm-neutral RGB toward the dedicated matched W/A emitters.
Raises native-white Jewelry pearls and Organ catches without tinting RGB.
Warms neutral RGB by lowering green and blue while W and A remain matched.

intent.safety_floor: Every fixture role carries a positive authored bed; evenness=1 remains complete and no moving fold can black out the rig.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Keep this the satin material/work-light member. Do not turn it into Breathe's global inhale, Shimmer's sparse points, Chase's processional bars, or Temple's candle vigil.
intent.evidence_notes: Source defaults and slider order match the prior registered source exactly; white_only now saves an explicit unmodulated operator-review tune for every control. The prior test-bench capture showed a mostly equal wash, motivating the new fixture hierarchy. The final source applies signed direction immediately, adds moving cross-grain satin ribs and selvedge, and concentrates native white in Jewelry catchlights. Cross-model truth reports zero WRONG, WEAK, or DEAD controls; exact saved-value silence/audio gates cover Titanic and test_bench. The gallery manifest fingerprints the exact source, goal registry, playlist, saved/effective values, duration, frame rate, and media shown on this row.
